Fetch students with an active IEP by district and grade

Source: R/sped_by_grade.R
fetch_sped_by_grade.Rd

Counts of students with an active IEP for every public school district and charter school, by grade, from NJDOE's response to OPRA request C255254. The workbook is bundled in the package and verified by SHA-256 on every read.

Usage

fetch_sped_by_grade(end_year)

Arguments

end_year

ending school year, 2022 through 2026 (2023-24 is 2024).

Value

a tibble with end_year, county_id, county_name, district_id, district_name, grade_level (PK, K, 01-12, NO_GRADE), n_students and suppressed, plus the standard entity flags.

Details

NJDOE suppressed counts under 5. A suppressed cell returns n_students = NA with suppressed = TRUE, never zero. A grade NJDOE left blank for a district has no row. The file has no statewide row and no denominators, and this function adds neither.

2025-26 looks incomplete. Statewide known counts fall 8% from 2024-25, grades 9-12 fall about 15%, and some large districts have no known counts. NJDOE has not explained this, so end_year = 2026 warns. The values are returned as released.

See also

fetch_sped for published classification rates.

Examples

# 1. Every district and grade for one year
fetch_sped_by_grade(2025)
#> # A tibble: 6,718 × 15
#>    end_year county_id county_name district_id district_name          grade_level
#>       <int> <chr>     <chr>       <chr>       <chr>                  <chr>      
#>  1     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… PK         
#>  2     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… K          
#>  3     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 01         
#>  4     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 02         
#>  5     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 03         
#>  6     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 04         
#>  7     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 05         
#>  8     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 06         
#>  9     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 07         
#> 10     2025 01        Atlantic    0010        Absecon Public School… 08         
#> # ℹ 6,708 more rows
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: n_students <dbl>, suppressed <lgl>, is_state <lgl>,
#> #   is_county <lgl>, is_district <lgl>, is_school <lgl>, is_charter <lgl>,
#> #   is_charter_sector <lgl>, is_allpublic <lgl>

# 2. One district, by grade
library(dplyr)
#> 
#> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:
#> 
#>     filter, lag
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:
#> 
#>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
fetch_sped_by_grade(2025) %>%
  filter(district_name == "Newark Public School District") %>%
  select(grade_level, n_students, suppressed)
#> # A tibble: 15 × 3
#>    grade_level n_students suppressed
#>    <chr>            <dbl> <lgl>     
#>  1 PK                 800 FALSE     
#>  2 K                  369 FALSE     
#>  3 01                 410 FALSE     
#>  4 02                 416 FALSE     
#>  5 03                 434 FALSE     
#>  6 04                 447 FALSE     
#>  7 05                 469 FALSE     
#>  8 06                 499 FALSE     
#>  9 07                 508 FALSE     
#> 10 08                 513 FALSE     
#> 11 09                 439 FALSE     
#> 12 10                 476 FALSE     
#> 13 11                 461 FALSE     
#> 14 12                 551 FALSE     
#> 15 NO_GRADE             3 FALSE     

# 3. Charter schools only, across years
lapply(2022:2025, fetch_sped_by_grade) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(is_charter, grade_level == "K")
